newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Incumbent president Ion Iliescu, candidate of the ruling Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) meets his rival Emil Constantinescu of the opposition Democratic Convention (CDR) bloc in the last face-to-face debate on state television starting at 1900 local.
State radio will also broadcast the debate.
* The electoral campaign for Sunday's presidential run-off closes at 2400 local on Thursday.
* Polling stations for Sunday's vote will be opened at 0600 local and close at 2100 local, said Costica Ionescu, head of the Central electoral bureau (BEC).
He said polling stations could be stay open after the deadline but not later than 2400 local.
* The accreditations for local and international observers at the November 3 parliamentary and presidential polls are valid for the presidential run-offs, Ionescu said.
* Liberal parties should merge into a new National Liberal Party, said Mircea Ionescu Quintus, head of a liberal party, now member of the CDR bloc.
He said the new PNL should run alone in the next parliamentary elections in the year 2000.
* The reform in Romania's army must continue, outgoing Defence Minister Gheorghe Tinca told a news conference.
He said Romania's top priority must be first-wave admission to NATO, together with neighbouring Hungary.
* The Alfa trade union federation opened its fourth congress in Bucharest. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
